provenance: Weights are a starting proposal derived from ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 — the per-item marking sheet used by FPTU graders is internal and NOT public (research 12, §7). Reweighted 2026-09-15 per rulebook 1.5 Q6 (ADR-0009): testable raised to .40 because it was the dominant failure on OTES — 44/44 requirements had no writable test case. Replace these numbers with the supervisor's real rubric when obtained; no code change needed.

uc_count.gate: Defense requires >=20 completed use cases (syllabus TDA clause); no upper bound (rulebook 1.5 Q1). Use case SIZE (3-7 transactions) is a separate criterion — see uc_size — and must not be folded back into this count.

language.source: syllabus: all documents required to write in English

uc_size.source: syllabus: medium use case = 3-7 transactions (action buttons, end-user interactions, DB transactions)
